title: 7 Killed in 24 Hours Across Gaza; Separate Drone Strike Kills Palestinian in Khan Younis Displacement Tent
detail: The Palestinian Health Ministry in Gaza said on Wednesday, August 26, 2026 that 7 Palestinians were killed and 10 others injured in Israeli attacks over the preceding 24 hours — 5 newly killed and 2 who died of earlier wounds. A medical source separately reported an Israeli drone strike on a tent sheltering displaced people in Khan Younis, southern Gaza, killing one more Palestinian. The ministry said the death toll from ceasefire violations since October 2025 has risen to 1,303 killed and 4,336 injured, while the cumulative total since October 7, 2023 stands at 73,438 killed and 174,447 injured. UN estimates put Gaza reconstruction costs at roughly $70 billion given the scale of damage to civilian infrastructure.

media.caption: Palestinian Health Ministry reports 7 killed in Gaza over 24 hours, Aug 26, 2026

title: Israeli Drone Strike Near Ansar Junction Kills Palestinian West of Gaza City
detail: An Israeli drone strike targeted an area near the Ansar junction west of Gaza City on Wednesday, August 26, 2026, killing one Palestinian, according to medical sources. The strike was reported as part of a continuing pattern of Israeli attacks in nominally ceasefire-covered areas of Gaza that day, alongside the separate drone strike on a displacement tent in Khan Younis.

media.caption: Israeli drone strike near Ansar junction, west of Gaza City, kills one Palestinian, Aug 26, 2026

title: Board of Peace Envoy Mladenov Warns Gaza Truce Collapse Would Be 'Point of No Return'
detail: Nickolay Mladenov, the Board of Peace's High Representative for Gaza, told the UN Security Council on Wednesday, August 26, 2026 that a collapse of the Gaza ceasefire would represent an irreversible catastrophe: 'There will be no roadmap to return to, there will be no administration to deploy and there will be nothing left on the ground to rebuild. That would be a point of no return for everyone.' He added that 'Gaza does not have another catastrophe left in it.' Mladenov criticized continued Israeli strikes and restrictions on shelter supplies, saying they have not and will not produce Hamas disarmament. Hamas agreed July 30 to a roadmap to surrender weapons to a transitional Palestinian governing authority under supervision of a US-led International Stabilization Force, but Prime Minister Netanyahu has publicly rejected the latest phase of the Trump peace plan, and Israel's deputy UN envoy Jonathan Miller said 'the plan cannot succeed while Hamas remains armed. Disarmament must come first.'

media.caption: Palestinians walk past a food-aid warehouse damaged in an Israeli air strike, Deir el-Balah, central Gaza, Aug 26, 2026
